source_locator: SARIG Mineral Deposit 3018: Deposit Type, Status, Summary, Major Commodities and Documents; Dmitrijeva et al. 2019 university scholarly repository Abstract
technical_findings: SARIG's primary government mineral deposit entry describes Acropolis as an unworked IOCG prospect, Cu major and REE minor, with hematite–magnetite alteration; 11 drillholes in 1986 explored roughly 50 km². The separate 2019 geochemical research analysed 4,864 whole-rock core samples from 14 drillholes and found an REE-W-Sn-Sb-U-Th association in hematite-dominant alteration. Those chemical footprints are exploration-geochemistry indicators, not an ore-body TREO resource, REE product recovery or economic study.
source_entity_scope: The official site ID is Mineral Deposit 3018 (Acropolis); archived source's DEPOSIT label must not imply a commercial independent Project. The 1986 / 2019 drill sets have differing purposes and cannot be summed as resource supports.
resource_basis_review: REE is minor associated element in IOCG; geochemical association not REO ore grade, resource category, oxide basis or saleable product.

Its 2025 named-project map lists separate operators/projects: Iluka WIM100/WIM50 with 1,380 Mt @ 5.0% HM, WIM Resource Bungalally/Avonbank, WIM150, Donald, Goschen Central, Goschen and Cannie. The 5.0% is HM grade, not TREO; regional resource summaries cannot be transferred to the generic GA 'Murray Basin' point or combined across companies.
